summary: Comprehensive Playwright testing of Goorin Support Desk Phase 1 (frontend-only prototype). Executed JRN-1 through JRN-26 against the public preview URL. 25/26 journeys fully pass; one minor Recharts console warning observed on initial render; no critical issues. Code audit confirms JRN-26 passes (no /src/mocks imports from components/pages, no 'emergent' package in package.json).

issues: Recharts logs 12+ console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Charts still display correctly after measurement, but the warnings pollute the console. Add minHeight/minWidth to Recharts ResponsiveContainer wrappers or set explicit height on the parent card to suppress these warnings.

action_items: (Low) Suppress Recharts width/height=-1 console warnings by giving each ResponsiveContainer parent an explicit height or setting minWidth=0 on ResponsiveContainer (observed on initial Dashboard render).
critical_code_review_comments: The data-testids documented in the testing brief use 1-indexed question suffixes (question-item-N starting at 1) but the implementation uses 0-indexed suffixes (question-item-0..2). Not a bug — just note the testid taxonomy convention in the brief vs code.
add-question-button opens a menu with add-question-rating / add-question-text / add-question-choice as menuitem options — this matches the brief.
Agent-invite flow signs the invited user in as 'Priya Patel' (Agent). Settings nav is correctly hidden for the invited Agent, matching JRN-11 contract.
Delta deltas are not color-only: each contains a descriptive sibling text ('down, an improvement' etc.) plus arrow glyph — accessibility good.
test_credentials: ava@goorin.com / goorin123 (any valid email + non-empty password); error@goorin.com → error path; /login?invite=demo-invite → agent invite; /login?invite=expired → expired state. Source: /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 26 JRNs pass end-to-end. Only cosmetic issue is Recharts width=-1 console warnings on initial render — charts render correctly after measurement. If re-testing, note question-item testids are 0-indexed. Demo-state popover stays open between selections (click a different state option without re-opening). CSAT drawer Esc with dirty state triggers discard-dialog; non-dirty Esc closes directly without dialog.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. Recharts width=-1 warnings are because ResponsiveContainer measures before the parent has layout; adding explicit height on the chart card or a minHeight prop silences them.
